## Supply chain / licensing

- [ ] No new third-party dependency
- [ ] New/changed dependency is pinned to an immutable revision

## Downloads / artifacts

- [ ] Existing component keeps one canonical install/remove/redownload surface

## Validation

List actual tests/workflows run and their results.

- [ ] Relevant automated tests passed

## Rollback / compatibility

Describe any compatibility risk, migration, backup, rollback, or user-data impact.

## Evidence

Link logs/runs and include hashes/versions when relevant.
